description.value: A private campground on the Canoe River in BC's central interior offering dedicated tent sites and a range of larger numbered sites; the website is essentially a booking page with almost no detail about the setting, facilities, or road access.

address.value: Yellowhead Hwy, Fraser-Fort George H, BC V0E 2Z0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a tourism=camp_site with WiFi (internet_access:type=wlan) and provides a working website URL. The booking subpage confirms an active campground with 7 dedicated tent sites (Tent A–G) and 31 numbered drive-in sites, all reservable online via a live booking system. The AMENITIES subpage returned only navigation/header content and no substantive amenity text, so nearly all optional amenity fields remain unverifiable from the website.
concerns: AMENITIES subpage returned only navigation and header content — specific amenities (showers, water, laundry, etc.) could not be verified from the website.
No address or phone number present in the OSM record.

Website pages display 'Anouk Voyenne Interior Design' branding at the top of some pages, suggesting a website-builder template where third-party branding was not removed — minor flag, but the booking system appears fully functional.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, independently operated campground with a functioning online booking system and 31+ sites; a legitimate and useful stop for touring cyclists in BC's Canoe River corridor.

wow_evidence: 7 dedicated tent sites (Tent A–G) and 31 numbered drive-in sites
